commands.short: Local LLM-powered code review of git diffs
Inspect and manage the local response cache
Remove cached LLM responses for this repo
Show metadata for a single cache entry by key
Drop old/excess cache entries (keep newest N + entries within age window)
Show cache entry count, size, age range, and per-provider breakdown
Generate a commit message from staged changes and commit
Shrink COMMITBRIEF.md losslessly via the configured provider
Show, get, or set individual configuration values
Print a single configuration value by dotted path
Write a single configuration value by dotted path
Print the merged configuration (API keys masked)
Run a review against an arbitrary git diff (passthrough)
Run a health check across the configured pipeline
Build prompt and report what would be sent; no API call
Gate a review against a declarative policy (.commitbrief/policy.yml)
Write COMMITBRIEF.md and a per-user OUTPUT.md template
Install (or uninstall) a git hook that runs commitbrief on commit
Scan the working tree and git history for committed credentials
Print the command reference
Draw the commit graph, highlighting what a filter selected
Run an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over stdio
List, switch, and test configured LLM providers
Show configured providers (active marker, model, API key status)
Ping a configured provider to verify the API key and reachability
Switch the active default provider (no API keys changed)
Drive GitHub operations (PR review) through the gh CLI
Review a GitHub pull request and post findings as inline comments
Interactive provider + API key wizard
Summarize a set of changes in plain language (read-only)
Check for a newer CommitBrief and install it

flags.name: allow-secrets
flags.usage: bypass the pre-send secret scanner (use with care)

flags.name: author
flags.usage: review only commits authored by these people (repeatable; matches name or email, case-insensitive). Switches the scope to a commit walk

flags.name: cli
flags.usage: use a locally-installed CLI tool (claude|gemini|codex) as the review backend; shorthand for --provider <name>-cli

flags.name: color
flags.usage: color output: auto, always, never

flags.name: committer
flags.usage: review only commits committed by these people (repeatable; matches name or email, case-insensitive)

flags.name: compact
flags.usage: one-line per finding (dense review output)

flags.name: copy
flags.usage: copy findings (severity, path, title, description) to the system clipboard via OSC 52 + native tool

flags.name: dir
flags.usage: review only files under these directories or matching dir globs (e.g. `internal/**`; repeatable, one pattern per flag); combines with the active scope flag

flags.name: end-date
flags.usage: review only commits on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive)

flags.name: exclude-dir
flags.usage: skip files under these directories or matching dir globs (repeatable, one pattern per flag); applied after --dir so an exclusion wins

flags.name: exclude-file
flags.usage: skip these files or globs (repeatable, one pattern per flag); same matching rules as --file, applied after it so an exclusion wins

flags.name: fail-on
flags.usage: exit 1 if any finding meets/exceeds severity (critical|high|medium|low|info|any|none)

flags.name: file
flags.usage: review only these files or globs (e.g. `*.go`, `internal/**/*.ts`; repeatable, one pattern per flag — patterns can't be comma-joined); combines with the active scope flag

flags.name: gen-man
flags.usage: generate man pages into <dir> and exit (hidden)

flags.name: gen-surface
flags.usage: write the CLI surface inventory to <file> and exit (hidden)

flags.name: ignore-unknown-config
flags.usage: continue when config.yml holds a key the schema doesn't define, instead of failing; every ignored key is still named in a warning on stderr (the setting has no effect — fix the key)

flags.name: json
flags.usage: emit machine-readable JSON output

flags.name: lang
flags.usage: AI output language (e.g. tr, fr); the CLI interface localizes for en/tr only, output for any recognized language. Resolution: --lang → repo config → user config → English

flags.name: markdown
flags.usage: emit plain markdown (no ANSI)

flags.name: max-commits
flags.usage: cap how many matching commits enter the review (0 = 200); only meaningful with another commit filter

flags.name: merges
flags.usage: include merge commits in a commit-filtered review (excluded by default); only meaningful with another commit filter

flags.name: min-severity
flags.usage: hide findings below this severity in the rendered output (critical|high|medium|low|info); --json and --fail-on still see the full set

flags.name: model
flags.usage: override configured model

flags.name: no-architecture
flags.usage: skip architecture-aware review (do not read architecture.json into the prompt) for this run (ADR-0030)

flags.name: no-baseline
flags.usage: ignore the signal-control baseline for this run (show everything, even baselined findings)

flags.name: no-cache
flags.usage: bypass cache (read and write)

flags.name: no-cost-check
flags.usage: skip the pre-send cost estimate prompt

flags.name: no-flaky
flags.usage: skip the deterministic flaky-test detector (ADR-0022)

flags.name: output
flags.usage: write output to file instead of stdout

flags.name: provider
flags.usage: override configured provider

flags.name: quiet
flags.usage: suppress info messages on stderr

flags.name: sandbox-rerun
flags.usage: confirm flagged flaky tests by re-running each in isolation N times (ADR-0022); mixed pass+fail = confirmed flaky, all-fail = real failure, all-pass = transient. 0 = off; bare --sandbox-rerun uses N=5. Requires a bound rerun executor

flags.name: show-prompt
flags.usage: print the exact system + user prompt that would be sent, then exit (no provider call, no cost)

flags.name: start-date
flags.usage: review only commits on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive)

flags.name: suggest-commit
flags.usage: after the review, suggest a Conventional Commit message for the staged diff (requires --staged; prints to stdout; not with --json/--markdown/--output)

flags.name: text
flags.usage: review only commits whose message contains this text, plus commits unique to a branch whose name contains it (case-insensitive)

flags.name: timeout
flags.usage: bound the whole run to this `duration` — 90s, 10m, 1h30m, or a bare number of seconds (600). Covers diff, provider call, render, and time spent at a confirmation prompt. Also RAISES the provider's own cap (claude/gemini/codex-cli 5m, ollama 5m, Anthropic SDK 10m), which a deadline alone cannot do. Unset or 0 keeps those built-ins. Resolution: --timeout → review.timeout → built-in

flags.name: update-baseline
flags.usage: rewrite .commitbrief/baseline.json from the current findings (accepts them all) instead of filtering this run; user-private, gitignored (ADR-0027)

flags.name: verbose
flags.usage: show token/cost/latency footer

flags.name: with-context
flags.usage: let the CLI provider read project files beyond the diff to ground the review (CLI providers only; the host CLI's agent reads your repo — see --help)

flags.name: yes
flags.usage: auto-confirm prompts (pre-send guard, init overwrite)

flags.name: staged
flags.usage: review staged changes (default)

flags.name: unstaged
flags.usage: review unstaged changes

flags.name: show-content
flags.usage: also print the cached review body (omitted by default)

flags.name: keep-last
flags.usage: keep only the N newest entries (per the provider/model filter); 0 means keep nothing

flags.name: model
flags.usage: only consider entries written for this model (matched against the model recorded in each entry)

flags.name: older-than
flags.usage: delete entries older than this age. Units: d (day), w (week), m (month, 30d), y (year, 365d)

flags.name: provider
flags.usage: only consider entries written for this provider (e.g. anthropic, openai, gemini, ollama)

flags.name: generate
flags.usage: offer N alternative messages to choose from (default 1, or commit.generate config)

flags.name: type
flags.usage: commit message format: plain|conventional|conventional+body|gitmoji|subject+body (default "plain", or commit.type config)

flags.name: dry-run
flags.usage: show the result summary; do not write or back up anything

flags.name: level
flags.usage: compression level: light | balanced | aggressive

flags.name: out
flags.usage: write result to this path instead of replacing COMMITBRIEF.md

flags.name: local
flags.usage: write to repo .commitbrief/config.yml instead of user-level

flags.name: quiet
flags.usage: only print warning and failed checks

flags.name: staged
flags.usage: review staged changes (default)

flags.name: unstaged
flags.usage: review unstaged changes

flags.name: diff
flags.usage: run-mode: review an arbitrary `git diff` range (e.g. main...HEAD); repeatable

flags.name: from-json
flags.usage: evaluate a prior schema-v1 review JSON (a file path, or - for stdin) instead of running a review

flags.name: policy
flags.usage: path to the policy file

flags.name: unstaged
flags.usage: run-mode: review the unstaged working tree instead of the staged index

flags.name: force
flags.usage: overwrite existing COMMITBRIEF.md / OUTPUT.md (alias of --yes for init)

flags.name: hook
flags.usage: git hook name (pre-commit | commit-msg | pre-push)

flags.name: uninstall
flags.usage: remove a previously installed hook (only one this command wrote)

flags.name: no-history
flags.usage: skip the commit-history half

flags.name: no-worktree
flags.usage: skip the working-tree half

flags.name: patterns
flags.usage: list the effective pattern set (built-ins + configured) and exit

flags.name: all
flags.usage: walk every branch, not just the given range (commit graph only)

flags.name: branches
flags.usage: show a branch topology summary instead of the commit graph

flags.name: local
flags.usage: write to repo .commitbrief/config.yml instead of user-level

flags.name: no-post
flags.usage: review the PR diff and print locally (no GitHub writes); enables --json/--markdown/--output/--copy/--cli like a local review

flags.name: repo
flags.usage: target repository owner/repo (overrides git context)

flags.name: request-changes-on
flags.usage: opt in to a request-changes verdict at/above this severity (critical|high|medium|low); omitted, the verdict is never request-changes (comment / approve only)

flags.name: alias
flags.usage: install a shell alias for commitbrief (default cbr); skips the provider wizard. Use --alias for an interactive prompt or --alias=<name> to set it directly

flags.name: local
flags.usage: save to repo .commitbrief/config.yml instead of user-level

flags.name: staged
flags.usage: review staged changes (default)

flags.name: unstaged
flags.usage: review unstaged changes

flags.name: check
flags.usage: only report whether a newer version exists; install nothing

mcp_tool_args.name: author
mcp_tool_args.description: Review only commits authored by these people (matches name or email, case-insensitive). Selects a commit set instead of a staged/unstaged diff.

mcp_tool_args.name: committer
mcp_tool_args.description: Review only commits committed by these people (matches name or email, case-insensitive).

mcp_tool_args.name: diff
mcp_tool_args.description: Arbitrary `git diff` arguments to review a range instead of staged/unstaged changes, e.g. ["HEAD~3","HEAD"] or ["main...feature"]. Forwarded verbatim to git.

mcp_tool_args.name: dir
mcp_tool_args.description: Review only files under these directories. A plain value is a <dir>/ prefix; a glob value is matched gitignore-style.

mcp_tool_args.name: end_date
mcp_tool_args.description: Review only commits on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

mcp_tool_args.name: exclude_dir
mcp_tool_args.description: Skip files under these directories or matching dir globs. Applied after `dir` so an exclusion wins.

mcp_tool_args.name: exclude_file
mcp_tool_args.description: Skip these files or globs. Same matching rules as `file`, applied after it so an exclusion wins.

mcp_tool_args.name: fail_on
mcp_tool_args.description: Report a gate failure (failed=true in the summary) when a finding meets/exceeds this severity. Findings are still returned regardless.

mcp_tool_args.name: file
mcp_tool_args.description: Review only these files. A plain value is an exact path; a value containing */?/[ is a gitignore-style glob (e.g. "*.go", "internal/**/*.ts").

mcp_tool_args.name: max_commits
mcp_tool_args.description: Cap how many matching commits enter the review (0 = the built-in default). Only meaningful alongside another commit filter.

mcp_tool_args.name: merges
mcp_tool_args.description: Include merge commits in a commit-filtered review (excluded by default). Only meaningful alongside another commit filter.

mcp_tool_args.name: min_severity
mcp_tool_args.description: Hide findings below this severity in the returned set (display filter; the gate still sees the full set).

mcp_tool_args.name: model
mcp_tool_args.description: Override the configured model for this review.

mcp_tool_args.name: provider
mcp_tool_args.description: Override the configured provider for this review (e.g. "anthropic", "openai").

mcp_tool_args.name: staged
mcp_tool_args.description: Review the staged diff (default true). Set false together with unstaged=true to review the working tree.

mcp_tool_args.name: start_date
mcp_tool_args.description: Review only commits on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

mcp_tool_args.name: text
mcp_tool_args.description: Review only commits whose message contains this text, plus commits unique to a branch whose name contains it (case-insensitive).

mcp_tool_args.name: unstaged
mcp_tool_args.description: Review the unstaged (working-tree) diff instead of the staged diff. Mutually exclusive with staged.

env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env_vars.effect: Anthropic API credential — overrides `providers.anthropic.api_key` in config.

env_vars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env_vars.effect: OpenAI API credential — overrides `providers.openai.api_key` in config.

env_vars.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env_vars.effect: Google Gemini API credential — overrides `providers.gemini.api_key` in config.

env_vars.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
env_vars.effect: DeepSeek API credential — overrides `providers.deepseek.api_key` in config.

env_vars.name: MISTRAL_API_KEY
env_vars.effect: Mistral API credential — overrides `providers.mistral.api_key` in config.

env_vars.name: COHERE_API_KEY
env_vars.effect: Cohere API credential — overrides `providers.cohere.api_key` in config.

env_vars.name: OLLAMA_HOST
env_vars.effect: Ollama base URL — overrides `providers.ollama.base_url` in config UNCONDITIONALLY, even if you set base_url explicitly.

env_vars.name: COMMITBRIEF_PROVIDER
env_vars.effect: Selects the active provider for this run — overrides `provider` in config.

env_vars.name: COMMITBRIEF_MODEL
env_vars.effect: Selects the active provider's model for this run — overrides `providers.<name>.model` in config.
